verses.restored: Great is YHWH, and greatly to be praised in the city of our God, in the mountain of his holiness.

familiar.text: Great is the LORD, and greatly to be praised in the city of our God, in the mountain of his holiness.

modern.text: Great is the LORD, and greatly to be praised in the city of our God, His holy mountain.

original.text: שִׁ֥יר מִ֝זְמוֹר לִבְנֵי קֹֽרַח גָּ֘ד֤וֹל יְהוָ֣ה וּמְהֻלָּ֣ל מְאֹ֑ד בְּעִ֥יר אֱ֝לֹהֵ֗ינוּ הַר קָדְשֽׁוֹ

verses.restored: Beautiful for situation, the joy of the whole earth, is mount Zion, on the sides of the north, the city of the great King.

familiar.text: Beautiful for situation, the joy of the whole earth, is mount Zion, on the sides of the north, the city of the great King.

notes.title: Zion language
notes.body: Zion is sacred-poetic geography in the psalm. Devotional attachment to Jerusalem must not be turned into a blanket modern territorial entitlement or a denial of another people’s dignity.

modern.text: Beautiful in loftiness, the joy of all the earth, like the peaks of Zaphon is Mount Zion, the city of the great King.

original.text: יְפֵ֥ה נוֹף֮ מְשׂ֪וֹשׂ כָּל הָ֫אָ֥רֶץ הַר צִ֭יּוֹן יַרְכְּתֵ֣י צָפ֑וֹן קִ֝רְיַ֗ת מֶ֣לֶךְ רָֽב

verses.restored: God is known in her palaces for a refuge.

familiar.text: God is known in her palaces for a refuge.

modern.text: God is in her citadels; He has shown Himself to be a fortress.

verses.restored: For, lo, the kings were assembled, they passed by together.

familiar.text: For, lo, the kings were assembled, they passed by together.

modern.text: For behold, the kings assembled; they all advanced together.

original.text: כִּֽי הִנֵּ֣ה הַ֭מְּלָכִים נֽוֹעֲד֑וּ עָבְר֥וּ יַחְדָּֽו

verses.restored: They saw it, and so they marvelled; they were troubled, and hasted away.

familiar.text: They saw it, and so they marvelled; they were troubled, and hasted away.

modern.text: They saw and were astounded; they fled in terror.

original.text: הֵ֣מָּה רָ֭אוּ כֵּ֣ן תָּמָ֑הוּ נִבְהֲל֥וּ נֶחְפָּֽזוּ

verses.restored: Fear took hold upon them there, and pain, as of a woman in travail.

familiar.text: Fear took hold upon them there, and pain, as of a woman in travail.

modern.text: Trembling seized them there, anguish like a woman in labor.

verses.restored: Thou breakest the ships of Tarshish with an east wind.

familiar.text: Thou breakest the ships of Tarshish with an east wind.

modern.text: With a wind from the east You wrecked the ships of Tarshish.

verses.restored: As we have heard, so have we seen in the city of YHWH of hosts, in the city of our God: God will establish it for ever. Selah.

familiar.text: As we have heard, so have we seen in the city of the LORD of hosts, in the city of our God: God will establish it for ever. Selah.

modern.text: As we have heard, so we have seen in the city of the LORD of Hosts, in the city of our God: God will establish her forever. Selah

original.text: כַּאֲשֶׁ֤ר שָׁמַ֨עְנוּ כֵּ֤ן רָאִ֗ינוּ בְּעִיר יְהוָ֣ה צְ֭בָאוֹת בְּעִ֣יר אֱלֹהֵ֑ינוּ אֱלֹ֘הִ֤ים יְכוֹנְנֶ֖הָ עַד עוֹלָ֣ם סֶֽלָה

verses.restored: We have thought of thy lovingkindness, O God, in the midst of thy temple.

familiar.text: We have thought of thy lovingkindness, O God, in the midst of thy temple.

modern.text: Within Your temple, O God, we contemplate Your loving devotion.

verses.restored: According to thy name, O God, so is thy praise to the ends of the earth: thy right hand is full of righteousness.

familiar.text: According to thy name, O God, so is thy praise unto the ends of the earth: thy right hand is full of righteousness.

modern.text: Your name, O God, like Your praise, reaches to the ends of the earth; Your right hand is full of righteousness.

original.text: כְּשִׁמְךָ֤ אֱלֹהִ֗ים כֵּ֣ן תְּ֭הִלָּתְךָ עַל קַצְוֵי אֶ֑רֶץ צֶ֝֗דֶק מָלְאָ֥ה יְמִינֶֽךָ

verses.restored: Let mount Zion rejoice, let the daughters of Judah be glad, because of thy judgments.

familiar.text: Let mount Zion rejoice, let the daughters of Judah be glad, because of thy judgments.

modern.text: Mount Zion is glad, the daughters of Judah rejoice, on account of Your judgments.

original.text: יִשְׂמַ֤ח הַר צִיּ֗וֹן תָּ֭גֵלְנָה בְּנ֣וֹת יְהוּדָ֑ה לְ֝מַ֗עַן מִשְׁפָּטֶֽיךָ

verses.restored: Walk about Zion, and go round about her: tell the towers thereof.

familiar.text: Walk about Zion, and go round about her: tell the towers thereof.

modern.text: March around Zion, encircle her, count her towers,

verses.restored: Mark ye well her bulwarks, consider her palaces; that ye may tell it to the generation following.

familiar.text: Mark ye well her bulwarks, consider her palaces; that ye may tell it to the generation following.

modern.text: consider her ramparts, tour her citadels, that you may tell the next generation.

original.text: שִׁ֤יתוּ לִבְּכֶ֨ם לְֽחֵילָ֗ה פַּסְּג֥וּ אַרְמְנוֹתֶ֑יהָ לְמַ֥עַן תְּ֝סַפְּר֗וּ לְד֣וֹר אַחֲרֽוֹן

verses.restored: For this God is our God for ever and ever: he will be our guide even to death.

familiar.text: For this God is our God for ever and ever: he will be our guide even unto death.

modern.text: For this God is our God forever and ever; He will be our guide even till death.

original.text: כִּ֤י זֶ֨ה אֱלֹהִ֣ים אֱ֭לֹהֵינוּ עוֹלָ֣ם וָעֶ֑ד ה֖וּא יְנַהֲגֵ֣נוּ עַל מֽוּת

translation_notes: This chapter completes corpus coverage as a ChatGPT-authored draft. KJV is retained as a familiar comparison layer; a separate automated reference pass adds BSB and pointed Hebrew without replacing the restored draft.
safety_note: Sacred geography must not be used to deny modern human rights, justify dispossession, or flatten contested history.
source_witness_audit_flags: Compare directly with WLC/OSHB, Septuagint, Dead Sea Psalms witnesses where extant, and other textual witnesses during the global audit. Preserve poetic parallelism, superscriptions, duplicate/parallel psalms, and significant Hebrew/Greek divergences rather than harmonizing them.
